sights.n: Sakai City Tea Houses Shin-an & Ōbai-an (伸庵・黄梅庵)
sights.address: 2 Mozusekiun-cho, Sakai-ku, Sakai, Osaka (inside Daisen Park, beside Sakai City Museum)
sights.w: Two tea houses in Daisen Park honouring Sakai's tea-master heritage (Sen no Rikyū); Ōbai-an is a Registered Tangible Cultural Property, and visitors can take matcha and wagashi here.
